context.body: The passage marks seven fulfilled days after the river is struck.
context.label: Seven days

observations.body: Moses is sent to meet Pharaoh at the riverbank in the morning with the rod in his hand.
observations.label: At the river

observations.body: The command names rivers, streams, pools, ponds, and even vessels of wood and stone.
observations.label: The scope widens

observations.body: The river changes, fish die, the river becomes foul, and Egyptians cannot drink from it.
observations.label: Water becomes blood

observations.body: Egyptians dig around the river for water because they cannot drink the river water.
observations.label: Another source is sought

payload.posture: Track the river, every named body of water, the rod, blood, fish, smell, and the search for drinkable water.
payload.tension: Pharaoh turns away without taking the sign to heart while Egyptians dig around the changed river for water.
payload.title: The river can no longer give drink
